patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero layout with large, bold text overlapping a full-bleed video, creating a dynamic and modern first impression.
Extremely large, bold sans-serif headings are used as primary visual elements, contrasted with smaller, legible sans-serif body text and decorative script for select section titles.
A stark dark mode theme predominates, featuring black backgrounds and white text, which makes vibrant, almost neon, accent colors in media and graphic elements pop dramatically.
An animated full-screen intro sequence (Image 2) featuring dynamic text and confetti-like elements serves as a preloader or brand introduction.
The homepage hero section features a full-bleed video playing in the background, providing dynamic visual interest.
Content sections are clearly delineated by generous negative space and distinct typographic styles for headings, often employing asymmetrical content blocks.

technique_notes: The site uses a full-screen animated intro sequence, likely powered by Lottie or custom JavaScript animation, to create an engaging brand introduction before the main content is accessible.
A full-bleed video is embedded in the hero section to provide immediate dynamic visual impact and showcase the agency's work, leveraging the 'video-hero' detection.
The site employs a stark dark mode theme, using black as the primary background and white for most text, allowing vibrant accent colors in media to pop.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold sans-serif headings (up to ~5x body text) create strong visual impact, complemented by a smaller, legible sans-serif for body copy and a decorative script for select section titles.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, with no visible rounded elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, with significant vertical and horizontal negative space, especially around headings and between sections, creating a spacious and modern feel.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, almost brutalist use of typography, featuring extremely large, high-contrast text against a stark black background. This is powerfully combined with vibrant, often glitchy or AR-style video and animated elements, creating a dynamic and cutting-edge aesthetic that immediately communicates a focus on immersive digital experiences.
